cause: All 11 CI failures wait for an agent payload from controlled in-process WebSocket gateways. The real stock execution guard introduced in a21 deliberately denies unverified dispatch after config.get, so those unchanged transport fixtures never receive agent requests.
classification: Test fixture compatibility regression caused by the intentional fail-closed guard. Not attributed to root permissions or timing/flakiness.

source_evidence.unrelated_changes: The import inventory branch is selected only by view=import; Rust changes are outside these WebSocket TypeScript fixtures.

fix: Only the two test files mock execution authorization, gated by per-fixture random IDs registered for the running gateway lifetime and exact OpenClaw agent ID. Real request and configuration validators still run; all other snapshots delegate to the real denying gate. Four added controls prove scope/revocation and model/sandbox denial.
